publishENFn: async function(key,t){const e=load('enCurrent');if(e.key!==key)throw Error('wrong page');const rr=await Promise.allSettled([tools.exec_command({cmd:'cat en-output.html',max_output_tokens:16000}),tools.exec_command({cmd:'cat en-output-qr.txt',max_output_tokens:4000})]);for(const r of rr)if(r.status!=='fulfilled'||r.value.exit_code!==0)throw Error(JSON.stringify(r));const html=rr[0].value.output.trim(),qr=rr[1].value.output.trim();const blob=await tools.mcp__codex_apps__github_create_blob({repository_full_name:load('repo'),content:qr,encoding:'base64'});if(blob.isError)throw Error(JSON.stringify(blob));const canonical='https://vinmat.eu/'+e.enPath.replace(/index.html$/,'');const redirect=''+t.name+'Open '+t.name+'';const done=[...load('enDone'),key],translations={...load('enTranslations'),[key]:t};const elements=[{path:e.enPath,content:html},{path:e.short+'index.html',content:redirect},{path:'ai-fantasy-adventure/assets/'+(e.kind==='best'?'bestiary-qr-en/'+key.split('/').at(-1):'catalog-qr-en/'+key)+'.png',sha:blob.structuredContent.sha},{path:'ai-fantasy-adventure/assets/catalog-en-progress.json',content:JSON.stringify({target:300,completed:done.length,updated:done,latest:key})},{path:'ai-fantasy-adventure/assets/catalog-en-translations.json',content:JSON.stringify(translations)}];if(load('saveENHelpers')){for(const p of ['build-en-page.py','check-en-page-card.cjs','en-catalog.json','en-common-translations.json','en-link-map.json','inspect-en-input.py']){const r=await tools.exec_command({cmd:'cat '+p,max_output_tokens:18000});if(r.exit_code!==0)throw Error(p);elements.push({path:'tools/aifa-en/'+p,content:r.output.trim()});}}const ref=await tools.mcp__codex_apps__github_fetch({url:'https://api.github.com/repos/'+load('repo')+'/git/ref/heads/main'});const head=JSON.parse(ref.structuredContent.content).object.sha;const tree=await tools.mcp__codex_apps__github_create_tree({repository_full_name:load('repo'),base_tree_sha:head,tree_elements:elements.map(x=>({mode:'100644',type:'blob',...x}))});if(tree.isError)throw Error(JSON.stringify(tree));const commit=await tools.mcp__codex_apps__github_create_commit({repository_full_name:load('repo'),parent_sha:head,tree_sha:tree.structuredContent.sha,message:'Translate complete Explorer page to English: '+t.name+' ('+done.length+'/300)'});if(commit.isError)throw Error(JSON.stringify(commit));const sha=commit.structuredContent.sha;const update=await tools.mcp__codex_apps__github_update_ref({repository_full_name:load('repo'),branch_name:'main',sha,force:false});if(update.isError)throw Error(JSON.stringify(update));store('enDone',done);store('enTranslations',translations);store('enLastCommit',sha);store('enLastHTML',html);store('enLastKey',key);store('saveENHelpers',false);text({saved:key,count:done.length,commit:sha});}
waitENFn: async function(){for(let i=0;i<35;i++){const r=await tools.mcp__codex_apps__github_fetch({url:'https://api.github.com/repos/'+load('repo')+'/actions/runs?per_page=10'});const run=JSON.parse(r.structuredContent.content).workflow_runs.find(x=>x.head_sha===load('enLastCommit'));if(run?.status==='completed'){if(run.conclusion!=='success')throw Error('Publication failed '+run.conclusion);const e=load('enCatalog').find(x=>x.key===load('enLastKey'));const v=await tools.mcp__codex_apps__github_fetch_file({repository_full_name:load('repo'),path:e.enPath,ref:load('enLastCommit')});if(v.structuredContent.content.trim()!==load('enLastHTML'))throw Error('saved page mismatch');store('enPublished',load('enLastCommit'));text({published:e.key,verified:load('enDone').length});return;}await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,10000));}throw Error('Publication still pending');}
completeENFn:

*** Delete File: en-input-translation.json
*** End Patch');await tools.apply_patch('*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: en-input-translation.json
'+JSON.stringify(t,null,2).split('
').map(x=>'+'+x).join('
')+'
*** End Patch');const build=await tools.exec_command({cmd:'python build-en-page.py '+key,max_output_tokens:1500});text(build);if(build.exit_code!==0)throw Error('page check failed');const card=await tools.exec_command({cmd:'NODE_PATH="$CODEX_PRIMARY_RUNTIME_NODE_MODULES" node check-en-page-card.cjs',max_output_tokens:1500});text(card);if(card.exit_code!==0)throw Error('card check failed');await eval('('+load('publishENFn')+')')(key,t);await eval('('+load('waitENFn')+')')();const next=load('enCatalog').find(e=>!load('enDone').includes(e.key));if(next)await eval('('+load('prepareENFn')+')')(next.key);}
